audio.text: Welcome! Today we’ll explore what React is and why it’s essential for modern web development.

React is a library that lets you build user interfaces with reusable components. It uses a virtual DOM to efficiently update the real browser DOM, and JSX allows you to write HTML-like syntax in JavaScript.

In summary, React simplifies UI development with reusable components, efficient rendering via the virtual DOM, and a declarative syntax. These features make it a powerful tool for building dynamic web applications.
